'''Ta'Mara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She worked as a cleaner at the house of the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Waz-alem Amir]], in the city of [[Hedrett]].
